o1: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity and ankyrin repeat binding activity; predicted to enable GTPase activity. Involved in endocytic recycling; receptor-mediated endocytosis; negative regulation of 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bisphosphate biosynthetic process; and presynaptic dense core vesicle exocytosis. Is located in Golgi medial cisterna; cholinergic synapse; and cytoplasmic vesicle. Is expressed in PVD; coelomocyte; hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis; and somatic nervous system. Is part of the receptor-mediated endocytosis pathway. Orthologous to human RAB10 (RAB10, member RAS oncogene family).
